answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, the agent economy requires nodes to pass continuous proof-of-bandwidth challenges before crossing the validation ledge into active peering. Identities must ingest and echo saturating traffic bursts, signing transmission receipts with a local cryptographic quill to incur verifiable transit and egress costs per counterfeit persona. This resource bottleneck prevents an adversarial ripple across consensus, though it penalizes honest edge agents with metered bandwidth.
